events.title: iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod impact
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got your hands on an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a device that changed everything for music lovers.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese comedy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius is undeniable.

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album tracks
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece with so many incredible tracks. Which one's on repeat for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true legend. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul influence
angles.copy: 61 years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: December 8th marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring message
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, whose message of peace and love continues to resonate. His music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic David Bowie was born on January 8, 1947, in Brixton, London.

angles.name: Bowie's influence
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator whose artistry continues to inspire.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Celebrating the King today! Elvis Presley would have been 92. His music still sounds as fresh and exciting as ever.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar god
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From the Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs changed rock forever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Rod the Mod
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! What's your favourite hit from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) was born on January 13, 1961, in Hastings, England.

angles.name: Madness legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic voice of Madness! From 'Our House' to 'Baggy Trousers', his music is pure British joy.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', was born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young hits
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! What's your favourite track from the '80s icon?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton was born on January 19, 1946, in Sevier County, Tennessee.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton! A true queen of country whose music and philanthropy shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow was born on January 20, 1971, in Frodsham, Cheshire.

angles.name: Take That icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite track he's written or performed?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean was born on January 21, 1950, in Fyzabad, Trinidad and Tobago.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta your dreams and into the comments with your favourite song from him!
